## About
TYC Service & Repair is a neighborhood auto shop on Manhattan Beach Blvd in Lawndale. We handle repairs and maintenance on foreign and domestic cars, trucks, vans and SUVs, and we have extensive experience on Japanese models like Nissan, Honda and Toyota.
When your car comes in, you get an in-depth look at its systems and a plain explanation of what it needs, so you can keep it running well for years. We use top brand name parts and fluids, and we stand behind our work.
Neighbors from Lawndale, Hawthorne, Gardena, Carson, Torrance, Redondo, Hermosa and Manhattan Beach bring their cars here, and we're rated 4.8 from 68 reviews on Google.

## Services
- Pre-purchase inspections: Buying a used car nearby? One reviewer buying from Manhattan Beach Toyota had us check the computer, brakes, engine and more while we talked them through it.
- Diagnostic services: A reviewer noted we have the same diagnostic gear the dealer has, so we can track down the real problem before you spend money.
- Engine replacements and oil changes: From a simple oil change to a full engine replacement, it's all done under one roof.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Foreign and domestic cars, trucks, vans and SUVs.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're in Lawndale and serve Lawndale, Hawthorne, Gardena, Carson, Torrance, Redondo, Hermosa and Manhattan Beach.

Q: Any tips for pulling into the shop?
A: One reviewer mentioned the turn in can be narrow when traffic is heavy. Take your time, and if you need to, just go around the block once.
